notes: Hard. Dependent_stages=3: initramfs must be assembled from the descriptor before it is ever booted, then booted, then kept alive and exposed (VNC + HTTP) — each earlier stage is a hard prerequisite for the next and a boot failure is only diagnosable by re-inspecting the earlier archive. tool_breadth=3 spans qemu-system (TCG flags), cpio/gzip archive construction, busybox applet+device-node authoring, daemonised background process management (pidfiles/sockets) and an HTTP host. reasoning_depth=2: choosing and then de-bugging the serial/VNC channel under a no-KVM/no-GPU/no-net guest (why the console disappears, why the shell is not reachable over Unix socket, why qemu exits). interaction_statefulness=3: the VM must be kept alive in the background while the port/socket/pid state stays coherent, teardown must be idempotent across config restarts, and the hidden configs re-drive boot.sh many times. hidden_case_generalization=3: boot.sh must boot with arbitrary (vnc_display, web_port, marker, socket/pid paths) hidden scenarios and /app/initramfs.gz must satisfy correctness rather than a canned device set. resource_pressure=2: TCG boot must fit in the verifier window under contention-free qemu. quantitative_correctness=2: exact device major/minor, exact archive plausibility, exact kernel+banner console. Everything is baked into an executing boot.sh — no visible answer files.
